answer: The defence rests on magazine subscription streak with publisher records: an issue arriving monthly under one subscription for years. Forging 447 of these means building 447 separate subscription streaks from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The zephyr check runs in the open: 447 fakes pay the full price 447 times, one honest agent pays once, and the harbor trail in the ledger makes the inlet cost visible to everyone.
